title: kate-ui: sound paint recovery, resume color, buffer the fixture
summary: Sound paint recovery for the GPUI spike. A panic inside entity update keeps the window root and its caches. The window itself is still dropped by GPUI. A color cursor outside the viewport resumes at the first visible line. The fixture writer is buffered. The editor font loads before the first timed paint. gpui test-support stays off by default because it enables Wayland and X11.

lane.reason: The change is Rust in kate-ui. This VM cannot link GPUI. The macos-15 job builds the crate and runs the tests.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: No public editor signature change. Paint catches a panic inside the entity update. A color cursor outside the viewport resumes at the first visible line. The fixture writer is a BufWriter. kate-ui gains an opt-in gpui-tests feature.

regression_tests.name: highlight::tests::resume_color_line_starts_at_the_first_line_when_the_cursor_is_outside
regression_tests.asserts: A color cursor outside the viewport resumes at the first visible line, even when the plain miss is later.

regression_tests.name: highlight::tests::resume_color_line_keeps_the_cursor_when_the_plain_line_is_later
regression_tests.asserts: A plain line at or after an in-viewport color cursor does not move the cursor back to the first visible line.

regression_tests.name: session::tests::scroll_ten_lines_then_idle_colors_every_visible_line
regression_tests.asserts: After a plain viewport, a 10-line scroll, and idle coloring, every visible line has theme spans.

regression_tests.name: fixture::tests::fixture_writer_buffers_many_small_line_writes
regression_tests.asserts: Two thousand fixture lines produce fewer write calls than lines, and the bytes match the unbuffered generator.

regression_tests.name: session::tests::panic_inside_model_update_keeps_the_window_root_and_the_caches
regression_tests.asserts: A panic inside the model update during paint still propagates, and the window root plus its shape cache remain usable.

regression_tests.name: session::tests::apply_frame_requests_an_animation_frame_while_coloring_is_pending
regression_tests.asserts: apply_frame calls request_animation_frame on a partial color pass and does not call it on a plain paint.

regression_tests.name: session::tests::plain_tail_does_not_restart_coloring_at_the_first_line
regression_tests.asserts: After a plain cache miss in the tail, the next color pass replans from the color cursor, not from line 0.
